summary: EAS iOS Meta (FBSDK) env-var config validation PASSED. 16/16 pytest cases green. Verified: (a) /app/frontend/eas.json JSON is well-formed; production.env and preview.env each contain EXPO_PUBLIC_META_APP_ID='2826139691089206' and EXPO_PUBLIC_META_CLIENT_TOKEN with exact 32-char length (value never logged; sha256[:8] fingerprint used for tracing); development profile intentionally has NO meta env keys. (b) node exec of app.config.js under simulated build envs: baseline (unset) -> 5 plugins & metaConfigured=false; production env -> 6 plugins & metaConfigured=true; preview env -> 6 plugins & metaConfigured=true. In both build cases the appended react-native-fbsdk-next plugin entry has appID='2826139691089206', clientToken (32 chars), scheme='fb2826139691089206', displayName='meemz', isAutoInitEnabled=true, autoLogAppEventsEnabled=true, advertiserIDCollectionEnabled=false — satisfying Meta auto-app-activation and trial-attribution requirements. (c) Untouched fields verified: cli.version='>= 7.0.0', cli.appVersionSource='remote', development(developmentClient/distribution/ios.resourceClass/ios.simulator), preview(distribution/ios.resourceClass/ios.simulator), production(autoIncrement/ios.resourceClass/ios.simulator/ios.buildConfiguration='Release'). (d) Regression: Metro serves HTTP 200 at http://localhost:3000 with no ModuleNotFoundError; backend GET /api/memes and POST /api/auth/register respond <500. No file edits were made to eas.json, app.config.js, or app.json.
critical_code_review_comments: app.config.js correctly gates FBSDK plugin behind BOTH env vars (Boolean(metaAppId && metaClientToken)) — safe against partial config.
Preview and production env values are identical for the meta client token; if Meta test/dev token separation is desired later, consider distinct values per profile.
Development profile has no env block — correct per requirement (dev builds will fall back to 5 plugins).
advertiserIDCollectionEnabled=false is App Store friendly (no IDFA prompt required). Confirm this matches product intent for iOS 14+ ATT strategy.
